_about: Budgets for scripts/perf/studio-perf.mjs, in milliseconds at 4x CPU slowdown in headless Chromium (the picture on the canvas, not the graphics chip). main = main-thread time per frame (what the code controls); frame = frame to frame; release = lifting the Pencil to the settled frame; once = a click to the next painted frame. Each is about 1.4x what the Studio measured when it was set (2026-11-08), so a change that slows an interaction fails the check. The target for every drag is one frame at full speed (16.7). Lower a budget when an interaction gets faster; never raise one to make a change pass without saying why in the PR.
